2	
3	from app import db

5	from app.models import Reserva, ReservaIn

8	router = APIRouter()
9	
10	
11	def sesion_actual(authorization: str | None = Header(default=None)) -> Session:
12	    if not authorization or not authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
13	        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="no autenticado")
14	    session = get_session(authorization.removeprefix("Bearer "))
15	    if session is None:
16	        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="sesion invalida")
17	    return session
18	
19	
20	@router.post("/reservas", status_code=201)
21	def crear_reserva(r: ReservaIn, session: Session = Depends(sesion_actual)) -> Reserva:
22	    try:
23	        validar_sala(r.sala)
24	        validar_horario(r.inicio, r.duracion_min)
25	    except ValidationError as e:
26	        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(e))
27	    return db.insertar_reserva(r, session.username)

RESERVA = {"sala": "Atlas", "inicio": "2026-10-05T10:00", "duracion_min": 60}


def test_crear_y_listar(client, auth):
    r = client.post("/reservas", json=RESERVA, headers=auth)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    creada = r.json()
    assert creada["usuario"] == "alice" and creada["sala"] == "Atlas"
    assert "inicio" in creada and "fecha" not in creada
    assert client.get("/reservas").json() == [creada]


def test_listado_ordenado_por_inicio(client, auth):
    client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "inicio": "2026-10-07T10:00"}, headers=auth)
    client.post("/reservas", json=RESERVA, headers=auth)
    inicios = [r["inicio"] for r in client.get("/reservas").json()]
    assert inicios == sorted(inicios)


def test_crear_sin_sesion(client):
    assert client.post("/reservas", json=RESERVA).status_code == 401
    assert client.post("/reservas", json=RESERVA, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer x"}).status_code == 401


def test_error_de_validacion_devuelve_422(client, auth):
    r = client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "sala": "Delta"}, headers=auth)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    assert r.json()["detail"]


def test_listar_reservas_filtra_por_desde(client, auth):
    client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "inicio": "2026-10-05T10:00"}, headers=auth)
    client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "inicio": "2026-10-06T10:00"}, headers=auth)
    client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "inicio": "2026-10-08T10:00"}, headers=auth)

    inicios = [r["inicio"] for r in client.get("/reservas?desde=2026-10-06").json()]
    assert len(inicios) == 2
    assert all(i >= "2026-10-06T00:00:00" for i in inicios)


def test_listar_reservas_desde_incluye_el_mismo_dia(client, auth):
    client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "inicio": "2026-10-06T08:00"}, headers=auth)

    assert len(client.get("/reservas?desde=2026-10-06").json()) == 1


def test_listar_reservas_desde_formato_invalido_devuelve_422(client, auth):
    client.post("/reservas", json=RESERVA, headers=auth)

    assert client.get("/reservas?desde=06-10-2026").status_code == 422


def test_listar_reservas_sin_desde_devuelve_todas(client, auth):
    client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "inicio": "2026-10-05T10:00"}, headers=auth)
    client.post("/reservas", json={**RESERVA, "inicio": "2026-10-08T10:00"}, headers=auth)

    assert len(client.get("/reservas").json()) == 2


def test_crear_con_fecha_en_lugar_de_inicio_devuelve_422(client, auth):
    reserva_con_fecha = {"sala": "Atlas", "fecha": "2026-10-05T10:00", "duracion_min": 60}
    r = client.post("/reservas", json=reserva_con_fecha, headers=auth)
    assert r.status_code == 422
